description: Creates an upload session for forensic media analysis. Returns the upload_uid and upload instructions. Upload each file with a single POST /api/upload carrying the file as the request body; its response reports ready_for_job_start, so no separate verification call is needed before snapwonders_analyse_job_start. Direct upload accepts files up to max_upload_bytes (returned in this response, currently 95 MB); anything larger must use the resumable TUS endpoint at /api/tus. Requires X-Api-Key header.
name: snapwonders_analyse_session_create
